tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have minimum 3 years of experience in the field of security printing. Enclose the experience certificate
The Tenderer shall be either proprietorship or partnership firm or a company registered under the companies Act 1956 or a registered society.
Printing unit location should be in Karnataka or any one of the Indian states shared borders with Karnataka state. Factory Registration Certificate from the competent authority has to be uploaded.
The Tenderer should be empaneled as Security Printers in Indian Banks Association (IBA) in respect with the Printing Unit (Tenderers applied & waiting for the IBA empanelment is not considered).

Copy of the PAN card of the firm has to be uploaded as detailed below. If a firm is sole proprietorship PAN card copy of the proprietorship. If a firm is partnership PAN card copy of the firm only (partners PAN card copy will not be considered). If a firm is private Ltd. or Public Ltd. Company, PAN card copies of the company.
EMD of Rs. 60,280/- should be credited to CeG account as per IFT Clause (4)

Bidders should have executed print and Supply of Marks Cards up to at least 50% of the tender quantity mentioned in the tender schedule in any one of the three Financial Years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 Upload relevant documents.

The tenderer shall submit A4 Size 10 sheets paper sample bearing details off Mill, GSM, to the Senior Assistant Director, B Section, Karnataka school examination and assessment board on or before the last date specified for the submission of Technical Bid as per the Tender Schedule. These samples are to be packed in separate covers duly indicating name and address of the tenderer on the sealed cover and on all the samples. The tenders without the samples shall be categorically rejected.

Board, if required will depute a team comprising technical expert and Board officials to inspect the printing press of the bidders, to verify the technical capacity of the printer to execute the tender work. Based on the report submitted by the team the technical bid evaluation committee will take appropriate decision on the technical eligibility of the Bidder.

If required, Bidder qualified for the above-mentioned criteria from Sl. No.1 to 12 shall give demonstration of overprinting of variable data. Bidders unsuccessful in demonstration or absent from the demonstration, shall be categorically rejected
The average turnover of the tenderer shall not be less than Rs.50 Lakhs in the financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Audited balance sheet and Profit and Loss account for the financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 has to be uploaded certified by Chartered Accountant.
Details of Income Tax returns filed for the years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 has to be uploaded i.e., assessment Years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 respectively.
